# AOSP OTA metadata schema

`ota_metadata.proto` and generated `ota_metadata_pb2.py` are unmodified copies
of `platform/build/tools/releasetools` from AOSP mirror commit
`045a3d6a3e359633a14853a5a5e1e4f2a11cbdae` (Apache-2.0). The accompanying
runtime is pinned separately in `requirements-ota-metadata.txt`.

Source: https://github.com/aosp-mirror/platform_build/tree/045a3d6a3e359633a14853a5a5e1e4f2a11cbdae/tools/releasetools
